result.note: Olympic hosting is peripheral to Prelims. This tests the 2036 contender list, the IOC timeline and the 2030 Commonwealth Games venue.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) named the countries in preliminary talks to host the 2036 Summer Olympics. Consider the following statements:
items: India is one of seven countries in these talks, alongside Qatar, South Africa and South Korea, among others.
The IOC is scheduled to make its final decision on the 2036 host in March 2027.
Ahmedabad is due to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong. March 2027 is when the IOC draws up a shortlist, with preferred hosts named in 2028 and a final decision in mid-2029. India has never hosted the Games, and the other contenders are Germany, Hungary and Turkey.
questions.source: The IOC will draw up a shortlist in March 2027, name preferred hosts in 2028, and make a final decision in mid-2029.
